class.name: TrainsetMemberData
class.brief_description: A vehicle of a trainset and how it stands in it.
class.description: Which vehicle it is ([VehicleData]), which way it stands, how far behind the vehicle before it and how it couples to the next one - a [code]dynamic[/code] of a scenery's [code]trainset[/code] ([TrainsetData]).

members.member: How it couples to the next vehicle of the trainset - read from the scenery, changed by the player in an arranged trainset; the flags that takes are what [method RailVehicleController.coupling_mode_get_flags] gives of what the couplers of both allow, when the trainset is placed ([method RailVehicleServer.trainset_place]).
Reversed in its trainset or not.
How far it stands behind the vehicle before it [m].
In a trainset as the player arranged it: its place in the trainset as the scenery declares it, front first, by which it is paired with its declared member; -1: a vehicle added to it.
